hook.text: If supply perfectly matched demand every second, warehouses wouldn't exist. But it never does.

buildup.text: Warehouses buffer the gap between production and consumption. They hold goods until they're needed.

discovery.text: They also enable bulk buying, seasonal storage, and faster delivery by positioning stock near customers.

twist.text: Some companies try to eliminate warehousing entirely through just-in-time. It works—until it doesn't.

climax.text: E-commerce increased warehouse demand by 40% in five years. Speed requires stock to be close by.

punchline.text: Warehouses exist because timing is never perfect.

quiz.question: Why do warehouses exist?
options: To buffer the gap between production and consumption
